title: Memory-V2V: Memory-Augmented Video-to-Video Diffusion for Consistent Multi-Turn Editing
abstract: arXiv:2601.16296v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video-to-video diffusion models achieve impressive single-turn editing performance, but practical editing workflows are inherently iterative. When edits are applied sequentially, existing models treat each turn independently, often causing previously generated regions to drift or be overwritten. We identify this failure mode as the problem of cross-turn consistency in multi-turn video editing. We introduce Memory-V2V, a memory-augmented framework that treats prior edits as structured constraints for subsequent generations. Memory-V2V maintains an external memory of previous outputs, retrieves task-relevant edits, and integrates them through relevance-aware tokenization and adaptive compression. These technical ingredients enable scalable conditioning without linear growth in computation. We demonstrate Memory-V2V on iterative video novel view synthesis and text-guided long video editing. translated_title: 记忆增强的视频到视频扩散模型用于一致的多轮编辑
translated_abstract: 视频到视频扩散模型在单轮编辑中表现出色，但实际编辑工作流本质上是迭代的。当编辑按顺序应用时，现有模型独立处理每一轮，常常导致先前生成的区域发生漂移或被覆盖。我们将这种失败模式识别为多轮视频编辑中的跨轮一致性问题。我们引入了Memory-V2V，一种记忆增强框架，将先前的编辑视为后续生成的结构化约束。Memory-V2V维护先前输出的外部记忆，检索任务相关的编辑，并通过相关性感知的标记化和自适应压缩进行整合。这些技术成分使得可扩展的条件化，而无需线性增长的计算量。我们在迭代视频新视角合成和文本引导的长视频编辑上展示了Memory-V2V。Memory-V2V显著增强了跨轮一致性。
tldr: Memory-V2V通过外部记忆和相关性感知整合机制，解决了多轮视频编辑中的跨轮一致性问题，显著提升了迭代编辑的稳定性和效果。
en_tdlr: Memory-V2V addresses cross-turn consistency in multi-turn video editing via external memory and relevance-aware integration, significantly enhancing iterative editing stability and quality.
